At 23, I’m diving headfirst into life in Peak City. There's this amazing program that offers free housing to young adults, funded by wealthy benefactors. Adrian, my longtime friend, and I were fortunate to be chosen.

Now we’re living with Anna and Josef, an incredibly generous couple who’ve opened their home to us. Their kindness gives us a real shot at finding our path in this vibrant city. Peak City is buzzing with opportunities, and thanks to Anna and Josef, we’re ready to explore every single one.
